foldAlef.description: Arabic only: treat alef variants, taa marbuta, and alef maqsura as their base letter (أإآ→ا, ة→ه, ى→ي). Off by default.

stripNiqqud.description: Hebrew only: ignore niqqud vowel points, which students usually omit when typing. On by default.
